components.name: Epilogue Fusion Operation Types
components.description: Declares operation descriptors and metadata traits for epilogue fusions including scaling, linear combinations, bias, activations, and block scaling.

components_relations.relation: invokes fusion callbacks and tensormap visitors

components.name: CuTe Tensor Layout Engine
components.description: Defines multidimensional tensor layouts, copy and MMA atom abstractions, tuple algebra, and architectural hardware operation traits.

components.name: Hardware Architecture Primitives (1.3.1)
components.description: Encapsulates architecture-specific inline PTX instructions and hardware intrinsics for MMA, copy, TMA, and cluster coordination across GPU generations.

components.name: Hardware Copy Primitives
components.description: Implements architecture-specific memory copy instructions, vectorization helpers, and tensor memory accelerator interfaces across GPU generations.

components.name: Base Matrix Math Primitives
components.description: Defines baseline fused multiply-accumulate and matrix multiply-accumulate primitives spanning SM61 through SM89 architectures alongside SIMD instructions.

components.name: Hopper Matrix Multiply Primitives
components.description: Provides Hopper SM90 warp-group matrix multiply-accumulate instructions, descriptors, and structured sparsity operations.

components.name: Blackwell Matrix Multiply Primitives
components.description: Encapsulates Blackwell SM100 unified matrix multiply-accumulate instruction primitives and descriptor encodings.

components.name: Cluster Synchronization Primitives
components.description: Manages thread block cluster discovery, barrier arrival, warp leader election, and distributed shared memory operations for SM90 and SM100.

components.name: Rubin Matrix Multiply Primitives
components.description: Defines SM107 architecture matrix multiply-accumulate instructions and UMMA descriptors supporting narrow precision formats.

components.name: SM120 Matrix Multiply Operations
components.description: Implements SM120 architecture dense and sparse matrix multiply-accumulate instructions.

components.name: Operation Atoms and Partitioning
components.description: Defines thread- and value-level copy and matrix-multiply atoms, traits, and tiled partitioners bridging hardware operations to tensor layouts.

components.name: Copy Atoms and Movement Traits
components.description: Defines copy atom wrappers, tiled copy abstractions, and memory copy traits supporting SM50 through SM100 architectures including TMA and im2col.

components.name: Core MMA Atoms and Partitioning
components.description: Provides core matrix multiply-accumulate atoms, tiled MMA abstractions, coordinate partitioning, and traits for legacy through SM89/SM107 architectures.

components.name: Hopper GMMA Traits
components.description: Implements Hopper SM90 GMMA traits, shared memory swizzled layouts, descriptor builders, and dense/sparse matrix multiply specializations.

components.name: Blackwell UMMA Traits
components.description: Implements Blackwell SM100 UMMA traits, tensor memory fragment management, instruction descriptor synthesis, and layout tiling helpers.

components.name: Block Scaled MMA Traits
components.description: Provides SM120 block-scaled and sparse matrix multiply-accumulate traits, scale-factor unpacking, and operand register shift transformations.

components.name: Layout and Tensor Abstractions
components.description: Provides multidimensional layout, tensor, pointer wrapper, and swizzling abstractions for index-space mapping and structured memory access.

components.name: Memory Pointer Adaptors
components.description: Provides memory space pointer tags and adaptors for global, shared, and register memory along with pointer recasting and striding.

components.name: Coordinate Mapping and Composition
components.description: Implements coordinate-to-index mappings, stride computations, slice wildcards, and composed layout mappings.

components.name: Core Tensor Layout
components.description: Defines multi-dimensional integer tuple containers and the core Layout abstraction mapping shapes and strides.

components.name: Swizzle Layout Transformations
components.description: Provides bitwise swizzling functions and swizzled layout compositions to avoid shared memory bank conflicts.

components.name: Tensor Representation and Engines
components.description: Implements multidimensional Tensor objects, storage engines, and tensor view zipping utilities.

components.name: Tensor Algorithms and GEMM
components.description: Implements higher-level algorithms for cooperative copying, GEMM execution, reductions, and partitioned data movement across tensors.

components.name: Fundamental Tensor Primitives
components.description: Provides foundational tensor and atom-level operations including element-wise copy, fill, clear, linear combination (axpby), GEMM execution, and arithmetic functors.

components.name: Thread Cooperative Operations
components.description: Implements multi-threaded cooperative algorithms such as partitioned cooperative copy, prefetching, and shared-memory GEMM across thread blocks.

components.name: Tensor Traversal and Reductions
components.description: Provides higher-order iteration, element-wise transformations, and multi-mode reductions over hierarchical tensor layouts.

components.name: Numeric Types and Arithmetic
components.description: Supplies compile-time integral constants, custom complex and real numbers, integer sequences, and static arithmetic functions.

components.name: Container Data Structures
components.description: Provides core GPU-compatible container types including compile-time tuples, aligned and subbyte arrays, bit fields, and type lists.

components.name: Metaprogramming and Tuple Containers
components.description: Provides compile-time meta-programming containers, host/device tuples with empty structure optimization, alignment utilities, and CUDA type wrappers.

components.name: Fixed Size Array Storage
components.description: Implements fixed-size sequential array containers with standard, memory-aligned, and subbyte element storage configurations.

components.name: Utilities and Layout Visualization
components.description: Supplies diagnostic utilities, SVG and LaTeX layout visualizers, type introspection traits, and formatting printers.

components.name: Core Types and Compiler Infrastructure
components.description: Houses core CUTLASS numeric types, memory helpers, launch abstractions, MLIR compiler dialect passes, and CI/CD automation tooling.

components.name: CuTe MLIR Compiler and Code Generator
components.description: Implements CuTe MLIR dialects, conversion passes targeting LLVM and NVVM, and composed layout code generation utilities.

components.name: CuTe Code Generation Engine
components.description: Provides compile-time layout abstractions, recursive variable algorithms, dynamic value tracking, and MLIR value emission utilities for CuTe.

components.name: CuTe IR Dialect and Lowering
components.description: Defines the CuTe MLIR dialect, types, operations, static folding transforms, and conversion passes lowering CuTe structures to base dialects.

components.name: Base Dialect Target Lowering
components.description: Configures base dialect registries, translation interfaces, and compilation passes that lower base MLIR representations to NVVM, LLVM IR, and GPU binaries.

components.name: CUTLASS Language Server Protocol Tool
components.description: Implements the Language Server Protocol executable for CUTLASS MLIR files by initializing dialect registries and running the LSP server main loop.

components.name: Continuous Integration and Testing Framework
components.description: Orchestrates continuous integration pipelines, build configurations, test execution suites, and environment reporting.

components.name: Common Test Execution Infrastructure
components.description: Provides shared utilities for command execution, environment detection, logging, and JUnit XML test reporting.

components.name: CuTe DSL Test Suites
components.description: Orchestrates CuTe DSL test suites, virtual environment setup, command construction, and validation flows.

components.name: C++ Test and Build Runner
components.description: Drives the main CI CLI entry point, CUTLASS C++ package build routines, and CTest functional test suites.

components.name: Pytest Runner and Plugins
components.description: Manages pytest process invocation, worker parallelization, crash stack decoding, and device plugin installation.

key_edges.description: Constructs and executes CuTe DSL test commands using the shared runner and test context
Runs CMake build and CTest execution commands using common execution runners and test contexts

components.name: Core Numeric and Functional Primitives
components.description: Defines fundamental numeric types, mathematical functors, tensor coordinate references, and device synchronization primitives.

components.name: Mathematical Utilities and Synchronization Primitives
components.description: Core arithmetic functions, complex and quaternion numbers, fast math utilities, and synchronization primitives like barriers and semaphores.

components.name: Numeric Data Types and Conversions
components.description: Numeric scalar types, precision definitions, constant tables, sub-byte integer encodings, and type-conversion operators.

components.name: Tensor References and Views

components.name: Tensor Elementwise Operations

components.name: Host Tensor Reference Operations
components.description: Provides host-side reference implementations for tensor traversal, initialization, reduction, elementwise manipulation, and numerical verification.

components.name: Device Tensor Reference Operations
components.description: Executes device-side reference kernels and helper routines for tensor comparison, filling, reduction, and elementwise processing on the GPU.

components.name: Tensor IO and Quantization Utilities
components.description: Supplies human-readable stream formatting for tensor views alongside mixed-precision quantization and dequantization routines.

components.name: Device Memory Management
components.description: Provides device memory allocation helpers, data movement functions, and specialized CUDA device utilities.

components.name: Host Reference Convolution and Matrix Operations
components.description: Implements host-side reference operations including host tensors, convolutions, symmetric and triangular matrix updates, and error checking.
